**Critical and Intensive Tweaks in Rendering for Increased Computation**  

Citric is a next-gen, ultra-lightweight **Minecraft optimization modpack** designed to **squeeze** every bit of performance out of the game. Unlike other packs, Citric prioritizes **raw FPS gains over visual fidelity**, making it the ultimate choice for players who want **maximum smoothness** at any cost.  

## ⚡ Features  
- **Optimized for Maximum FPS** – Uses the most aggressive tweaks to boost performance.  
- **Lightweight and Efficient** – Only includes necessary optimizations, nothing extra.  
- **No unnecessities** - Cuts down all the unnecessary renders for Minecraft to ensure the maximum output.  
- **Sodium-Based** – Ensures wide compatibility with most mods, supporting **Minecraft 1.21.4 and beyond**.  

## 📜 Included Mods  
<details>  
<summary>Click to expand</summary>  

## Core Optimization Mods  

- **Sodium** – The foundation of Citric, Sodium replaces Minecraft’s vanilla renderer with a much more efficient one, drastically improving frame rates.  
- **Lithium** – Optimizes physics calculations, AI processing, and world ticking, reducing unnecessary CPU usage and improving server-side performance.  
- **Palladium** – Provides deduplication, improved memory control, shader/chunk/nbt optimizations and enchanced mob AI.
- **Alternate Current** – Replaces Minecraft's redstone simulation with a more efficient system, reducing lag from complex redstone contraptions.  
- **FerriteCore** – Reduces memory usage by optimizing how Minecraft stores block and chunk data, helping with RAM efficiency.  

## Rendering & FPS Enhancements  

- **More Culling** – Prevents Minecraft from rendering unnecessary parts of the world by aggressively culling blocks, reducing GPU workload.  
- **Entity Culling** – Skips rendering entities that are not visible to the player, drastically improving performance in entity-heavy areas.  
- **Cull Leaves** – Optimizes the rendering of tree leaves by reducing transparency calculations, helping with GPU load.  
- **ImmediatelyFast** – Removes various animation delays and improves immediate rendering of UI elements, increasing responsiveness.  
- **Exordium** – Optimizes rendering of GUI elements to use fewer resources, improving performance in menus and inventory screens.  

## Chunk & World Optimization  

- **Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (CCME)** – Replaces vanilla’s chunk loading system with an asynchronous, parallelized approach, significantly improving chunk loading speeds.  
- **Async** – Further optimizes async operations, reducing main-thread overhead related to chunk loading and saving.  
- **ScalableLux** – Enhances block lighting updates for better multithreading efficiency, reducing lag spikes caused by lighting calculations.  
- **Collision Fix** – Fixes inefficient collision detection, preventing unnecessary CPU cycles from being wasted on physics calculations.  

## Memory & Backend Improvements  

- **Enhanced Block Entities** – Improves how Minecraft handles block entities like chests and signs, reducing FPS drops in areas with many interactive blocks.  
- **ToadLib** – A lightweight performance library that enhances compatibility between optimization mods.  
- **YetAnotherConfigLibrary** – Provides an advanced configuration system for Citric, allowing for fine-tuning of settings.  
- **Noisium** – Optimizes noise generation, which is critical for terrain and biome generation, reducing world-gen lag.  

## Essential Dependencies  

- **Fabric API** – The core library required for most Fabric mods, ensuring compatibility.  
- **Sodium Extra** – Adds additional configuration options to Sodium, allowing for further tweaking of graphics settings.  
- **Text Placeholder API** – Provides an optimized text rendering system, reducing lag in UI-heavy environments.  
- **Cloth Config API** – Enables smooth configuration management for all mods in Citric.  

---

These optimizations work together to create an ultra-lightweight, high-performance experience, ensuring maximum FPS without unnecessary visual enhancements. Citric is designed for players who prioritize raw performance over aesthetics. 

</details>  

## 🔧 Ideal Use Case  
Citric is perfect for:  
- **Low-end PCs** that struggle with Minecraft’s default performance. They benefit the most from Citric.  
- **Competitive players** who need **the highest FPS possible** for smooth gameplay.  
- **Anyone who values raw speed** over graphical fidelity.

1. Install Citric through Modrinth.  
2. Launch Minecraft and enjoy the **fastest** experience possible!
